title: Past Participle: Regular dan Irregular

stages.name: Teori
stages.content:
## Past Participle: Regular dan Irregular

**Past participle (V3)** adalah bentuk kata kerja ketiga, dipakai di present perfect. Ada dua jenis: **regular** (berakhiran -ed) dan **irregular** (harus dihafal).

### 1. Regular verbs

V3 = bentuk dasar + **-ed** (sama dengan past simple).

| V1 | V2 (past) | V3 (participle) |
|---|---|---|
| recycle | recycled | recycled |
| plant | planted | planted |
| reduce | reduced | reduced |
| clean | cleaned | cleaned |
| protect | protected | protected |

### 2. Irregular verbs (wajib dihafal)

| V1 | V2 (past) | V3 (participle) | Arti |
|---|---|---|---|
| go | went | gone | pergi |
| see | saw | seen | melihat |
| do | did | done | melakukan |
| have | had | had | punya |
| make | made | made | membuat |
| take | took | taken | mengambil |
| give | gave | given | memberi |
| write | wrote | written | menulis |
| build | built | built | membangun |
| cut | cut | cut | memotong |

### 3. Pola kalimat

- We **have recycled** plastic. (regular)
- She **has seen** the pollution. (irregular: see → seen)
- They **have done** a cleanup. (irregular: do → done)

### 4. Hati-hati: V2 vs V3

Di present perfect selalu pakai **V3**, bukan V2.

> Salah: I have **went** to the beach. (went = V2)
> Benar: I have **gone** to the beach. (gone = V3)

### 5. Mini-dialogue

> A: **Have** you **done** the cleanup?
> B: Yes, we **have done** it. We **have collected** ten bags of trash.
> A: **Has** she **seen** the new forest?
> B: Yes, she **has seen** it. It **has grown** a lot.

> **Hindari:** "I have went." (salah — *I have gone.*)
> **Hindari:** "She have seen." (salah — *She has seen.*)

### 6. Tip

Hafalkan irregular dalam triple: **go-went-gone, see-saw-seen, do-did-done**. Kelompokkan yang polanya sama (cut-cut-cut, build-built-built).
key_points: Irregular harus dihafal triple: go-went-gone, see-saw-seen, do-did-done
Present perfect selalu pakai V3, bukan V2
Salah: 'I have went'; Benar: 'I have gone'
Kelompokkan irregular yang polanya sama untuk hafalan

vocabulary.example_en: Air pollution is a big problem.
Reduce the use of plastic bags.
Plastic takes years to break down.
Don't throw trash in the river.
The river is very dirty now.
The ocean is full of plastic.

vocabulary.example_id: Kita sebaiknya menanam lebih banyak pohon.

stages.name: Latihan
stages.instructions:
Latihan terstruktur 20 menit:
1. Drill: guru menyebut V1, murid jawab V3 (go→gone, see→seen, recycle→recycled).
2. Pair work: buat 6 kalimat present perfect dengan irregular verbs (done, seen, built, written).
3. Fill-in-the-blank: 10 kalimat dengan V3 yang benar (regular & irregular).
4. Error correction: perbaiki 5 kalimat (mis. 'I have went', 'She have done').
5. Triple memory: tulis 12 irregular verbs dalam bentuk V1-V2-V3 di buku catatan.

Tugas rumah: Hafalkan 12 irregular verbs triple, lalu tulis 6 kalimat present perfect dengan irregular V3.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Have you done the recycling this week?
dialogue.id: Apakah kamu sudah melakukan daur ulang minggu ini?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Yes, I have done it every Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Has your class built a compost bin?
dialogue.id: Apakah kelasmu sudah membuat tempat kompos?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Yes, we have built one behind the school.
dialogue.id: Ya, kami sudah membuatnya di belakang sekolah.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Have you seen the new recycling ads?
dialogue.id: Apakah kamu sudah melihat iklan daur ulang baru?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Yes, I have seen them on TV.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Has the school taken action on waste?
dialogue.id: Apakah sekolah sudah mengambil tindakan soal limbah?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Yes, it has taken big steps this year.
dialogue.id: Ya, sudah mengambil langkah besar tahun ini.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.en: Have you written a report about pollution?
dialogue.id: Apakah kamu sudah menulis laporan tentang polusi?

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Yes, I have written one for science class.
dialogue.id: Ya, saya menulisnya untuk pelajaran sains.

dialogue.speaker: Student
dialogue.en: Yes, it has gotten much cleaner.

stages.name: Penutup
stages.teacher_script: Bagus sekali, anak-anak! Hari ini kita sudah belajar 'Past Participle: Regular dan Irregular'. Mari kita cek pemahaman: coba sebutkan satu hal penting yang kamu pelajari hari ini. (Tunggu 2-3 murid menjawab, beri umpan balik.) Apakah ada yang masih bingung? (Jawab pertanyaan jika ada.) Untuk PR di rumah: Hafalkan 12 irregular verbs triple, lalu tulis 6 kalimat present perfect dengan irregular V3. Pelajaran berikutnya kita akan membahas penggunaan present perfect dalam konteks, jadi silakan baca sekilas persiapan di rumah. Terima kasih sudah aktif dan antusias hari ini. Sampai jumpa!
stages.instructions: Berikan pujian singkat. Cek pemahaman dengan 1-2 pertanyaan. Sampaikan PR dengan jelas. Beritahu topik pertemuan berikutnya. Tutup dengan positif.
